title: Building a Simple JSON API
learning_objectives: Set up a minimal local back-end runtime (e.g., Node.js or equivalent)
Define one or more HTTP endpoints that return JSON
Run the API locally and hit it from a client (browser or tool)
Explain at a high level how route handlers map URLs to responses
outline: Recap: what an API is and how clients call it
Setting up a simple development environment
Running and testing the API locally

format: Code for a minimal API server with at least two endpoints
Evidence of successful requests to each endpoint

constraints_for_professor: Keep to a single, minimal back-end stack
Avoid authentication, databases, or complex middleware at this stage
